module pulp_clock_mux2
  (
   input  logic clk0_i,
   input  logic clk1_i,
   input  logic clk_sel_i,
   output logic clk_o
   );
   
   always_comb
     begin
	if (clk_sel_i == 1'b0)
	  clk_o = clk0_i;
	else
	  clk_o = clk1_i;
     end
   
endmodule
